children: New York, September 10, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has assigned credit enhanced Aa2 to the Custodial Receipts, Custodial Receipts, Series 2026- MIZ9272 evidencing ownership of Dormitory Authority of the State of New York Royal Charter Properties-East, Inc. Senior Secured Revenue Bonds, Series 2025. The Receipts are supported by a standby letter of credit from Mizuho Capital Markets LLC. The obligations of MCM under the LOC are guaranteed by Mizuho Bank, Ltd..

title: Moody's Ratings assigns credit enhanced Aa2 to Custodial Receipts (Mizuho Bank), Custodial Receipts, Series 2026-MIZ9272
